Build the "Client profile beef up" feature in the Nxeon admin portal. Work EXCLUSIVELY in the git worktree at /opt/nxeon-wt-client-profile (branch feature/admin-client-profile). Do not touch /opt/nxeon or other worktrees. node_modules is already symlinked there.

OWNER ASK: "in admin portal, I only see servers on client profiles and not the rest of the services, we need to beef these up so they are up to date. also need to add more info to client profiles, also lets add notes as well."

RULES (critical):
- Do NOT run `npm run build`, `next build`, `prisma generate`, or `prisma db push`. Write code only (staging is the gate; the orchestrator runs it).
- READ FIRST: the current admin client/customer profile page (under app/admin/ — likely app/admin/customers/[id] or app/admin/users/[id]), the admin server actions, and lib/rbac.ts for area gating. Match its layout, components, and RBAC exactly. Guard every new action with the same admin/RBAC check the surrounding code uses.

SCOPE:
1. Show ALL of the customer's services, not just VPS servers: VPS/game Servers, Shared Hosting (HostingAccount), Business Email (EmailSubscription), Domains, and a wallet/invoice summary — each a clear section with status + key facts + manage links. Grep prisma/schema.prisma for the models related to User to get the real relations.
2. More account info: signup date, wallet balance, lifetime spend / invoice totals, last login (if the field exists), team members (if any), 2FA status (if available). ONLY show fields that actually exist on the models — never invent.
3. Admin NOTES: let an admin add/edit freeform notes on a customer. Add the cleaner of: a CustomerNote model { id, userId, authorId, body, createdAt } OR a notes field on User — follow existing schema style. Add an admin-guarded server action to save notes (audit-log if the repo has that pattern) + a small notes UI.

DELIVER end-to-end (schema + server actions + admin UI), then in the worktree:
1. `git add -A && git commit -m "feat: admin client profile — all services + account info + notes"` ending with: Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
2. `git push -u origin feature/admin-client-profile`
REPORT (factual): files changed, exact schema changes, the admin-guard used, service types wired in. Don't claim tested.

Done. Committed and pushed to `feature/admin-client-profile`.

## What was built

Beefed up the admin client profile at `app/admin/users/[id]/page.tsx` to show every service line, more account info, and internal admin notes.

### Files changed
- `prisma/schema.prisma` — added `CustomerNote` model + two relations on `User`.
- `lib/actions.ts` — 3 new admin-guarded server actions.
- `app/admin/users/[id]/page.tsx` — expanded query + new sections.
- `components/admin/CustomerNotes.tsx` — new client component (notes UI).

### Schema change (exact)
New model:
```
model CustomerNote {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId    String
  user      User     @relation("CustomerNoteSubject", fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  authorId  String
  author    User     @relation("CustomerNoteAuthor", fields: [authorId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  body      String
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt
  @@index([userId, createdAt])
}
```
Plus two back-relations added to `User`: `customerNotes CustomerNote[] @relation("CustomerNoteSubject")` and `authoredCustomerNotes CustomerNote[] @relation("CustomerNoteAuthor")`. Additive only — nothing dropped/renamed.

### Admin guard used
